items.title: The five components of building a "company harness"
items.en_title: The five components of building a "company harness"
items.en_oneliner: LangChain shares how it built internal agents for marketing, sales, and engineering — and how those agents reshaped the way each team works.

items.en_title: Devin Security 2.0: Built for the new threat landscape
items.en_oneliner: Devin Security 2.0 scans code with frontier models, ranks findings against your real environment, and turns them into fix pull requests on its own.

items.title: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
items.en_title: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI shares what its models achieved on quantum chromodynamics, the Kakeya conjecture, and the Exponential Time Hypothesis — and how researchers can check the work and take it further.

items.title: GPT-6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit strengthen security across complex codebases
items.en_title: GPT-6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit strengthen security across complex codebases
items.en_oneliner: CodeRabbit is using GPT-6.1 Sol to look into security risks in complex codebases, with its security agent helping developers go over findings and suggested fixes.

items.title: ChatGPT’s expanding world of work
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI Signals data spans 165 work activities in nearly 100 countries, showing how people work with ChatGPT and how their usage shifts over time.

items.title: How Fanatics and OpenAI streamline the fan experience
items.en_title: How Fanatics and OpenAI streamline the fan experience
items.en_oneliner: Fanatics is using OpenAI to help fans put together game-day outfits through Shop the Look, and in a test of roughly 30,000 MLB products, engagement rose 10%.

items.en_title: How Ultrafast cut incident investigation from hours to minutes at OpenAI
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI engineers run incident investigations in minutes with Codex Ultrafast, and security analysis, code refactoring, and everyday work all move faster too.
